lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in a roughly grid-like spatial distribution posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal blob rows, forming nodes of peak luminance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Strong linear feature with a high-to-low vertical luminance gradient extending horizontally across the mid-upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Cluster of approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs distributed across the anterior and medial sections of the dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast caustic network (refracted light patterns) overlaid across the dorsal and upper-lateral surfaces.
